XR Game
CatNet is an AR game that incorporates neural networks. The game is developed using Unity, utilizing the Unity Barracuda plugin to deploy lightweight neural networks to mobile games. It enables real-time recognition, classification, and feature extraction of real-life organisms using the smartphone camera through neural networks. The obtained data is then used to programmatically generate corresponding 3D models. This project serves as an experimental exploration of potential directions for future AR games. Chronoscape is an XR interactive game installation developed using the UE5 engine. In this project, human existence is extended into a virtual digital world through gaming experiences. Our goal is to design an immersive playground space that amplifies and commemorates the impact individuals have on the world. The project is developed using Unreal Engine and incorporates a self-trained YOLO network deployed in the game through OpenCV and experimental neural network modules. A camera positioned at the top tracks human traces in real-time within the scene and feeds back into the game environment.
